status: Exploratory protocol fixed after a small h=0.2 pilot, before the full comparison; not preregistered or held-out validation.
model: Unchanged vacuum KS WDW positive-frequency branch, intrinsic T=log(a), L2(dx) inner product
observable: Pr(r/r_ref < eta) = Pr(x > x0-T-log(eta)); sphere scalar S=2/r^2. NOT full 4D Kretschmann.
interpolation: Piecewise-linear nonnegative density with zero wall values; exact subcell integrals; no renormalization
classical_control: Independent 1D conditional-Gaussian adaptive integral of same initial positive Wigner ensemble; refinement epsabs and epsrel
scope: Finite set of states, clock times and thresholds. Empirical regulator comparison, not a certified continuum error bound or prediction for nature.
